caption: The drawing depicts a single ornamental object rendered in grayscale, positioned centrally on a plain, light background. The object consists of an elaborate, vertically oriented stand featuring intricate scrollwork, foliage motifs, and stylized acanthus leaves throughout its structure. The base is broad with an irregular, undulating edge that also incorporates leaf-like patterns, giving it a textured, organic appearance. Extending upward from the base, the shaft curves and loops with additional leaf designs, connecting to a horizontal element near the upper third, which appears to function as a handle or support. Above this crosspiece, a further section rises and culminates in an ornate finial that continues the leafy motif and includes a small ring and more tightly coiled scrolls. The entire object appears metallic based on the detailed shading, though the drawing does not indicate any real color beyond the grayscale tones. The drawing is executed with fine lines and shading to highlight the raised and recessed areas of the decoration. The background remains unadorned except for faint border marks at the corners.
title: Umbrella Stand
